HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Diligence questions from Mark Moe, with answers from Jane Doe, May 20, 2011
Q. What is monthly churn? A. Monthly logo churn is 1.2 percent.
Q. What is the customer concentration? A. Sunrise Diner Group is our largest
customer, with 14 kitchens.
Q. Does any former employer have a claim to the code? A. No former employer has any
claim to the code.
Q. How many staff do you expect at year end? A. Seven, including the two founders.
Q. Where is hosting? A. Example Hosting, under a 12-month agreement.
